collection.title: Great Wall Steed 2012 to 2017 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Great Wall Steed 2012 to 2017 Onwards model which requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
